'The Official Opening of the Magnificent Wurlitzer Theatre Pipe Organ'. Featuring Tony Fenelon and Margaret Hall (organists). Including Les Stenersen, John Parker and Colin Kay. Performed at the Hollywood Theatre, Avondale, Auckland. November 6, 1982 (programme)[Includes photographs of Tony Fenelon, Margaret Hall, the organ, John Parker, Les Stenerson, Peter Kent, Harry Walsh, John Johnson, Alf Brant]

'Wurlitzer Theatre Pipe Organ Concert'. Held at the Hollywood Cinema, Avondale. Featuring Richard Hore and Margaret Hall. May 1, 1983 (A3 photocopied poster)

'Ron Clark at the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Held at the Hollywood Cinema, Avondale. May 15, 1988 (A4 photocopied poster)

'Denis McCombe at the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Held at the Hollywood Cinema, Avondale. Presented by the Theatre Organ Society. July 17, 1988 (A4 photocopied poster)

'Robert Wolfe' - Down Under Concert Tour. Performed at the Baycourt Centenary Theatre, Tauranga (February 8), The Hollywood Theatre, Avondale (February 11), Southward Museum Trust Theatre, Paraparaumu, Wellington (February 12). 1989 (programme)

'Robert Wolfe' - Down Under Concert Tour. In association with the Theatre Organ Society of Auckland. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, Avondale (February 25 and 28), the Southward Museum Trust, Paraparaumu, Wellington (March 3 - 4), Baycourt Centenary Theatre, Tauranga (March 10 - 11). 1990 (souvenir programme)[Includes photograph of Robert Wolfe]

'At the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Featuring Nicholas Martin (from UK). Performed at the Hollywood Theatre, Avondale. August 8, 11, 1993 (A4 poster)

'Chris Powell at the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. June 7, 1998 (A4 poster)

'Ken Double at the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. July 12, 1998 (A4 poster)

'Margaret Hall at the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. August 30, 1998 (A4 poster)

'Denis McCombe at the Mighty Wurlitzer'. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. March 28, 1999 (A4 poster)

'A Pops Concert'. Presented by Jan Grefstad's Hollywood Theatre and the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Jelani Eddington (organ). Performed at Hollywood Theatre, St. Georges Road, Avondale. March 2, 2003 (A4 poster)

'Pops on Pipes'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring David Gray (organist, Scotland). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. August 15, (2004?) (A4 poster)[Includes photograph of David Gray]

'Pipes n Pizzazz'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Margaret Hall (organist, Australia) and Brett's Internationals (1920s style dance band). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St George's Bay Road, Avondale. September 5, 2004 (A4 poster)

'It's De-Lovely'. Featuring Greg Ward, with John Atwell (Wurlitzer Organ). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. April 10, 2005 (A4 poster)

'Pops on Pipes'. Presented by The Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Richard Hore (organist). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St George's Bay Road, Avondale. March 6, 2005 (A4 poster)

'Pops on Pipes'. Presented by The Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Chris Powell (organist, Britain). Performed at Hollywood Cinema, Avondale. June 26, 2005 (A4 poster)

'City Lights' starring Charlie Chaplin, accompanied by Ron Clark on The Wurlitzer Organ. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. November 20, 2005 (A4 poster)

'Pops on Pipes'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Mark Herman (organist, U.S.A). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. July 9, (2006?) (A4 poster)[Includes photograph of Mark Herman]

'Pops on Pipes!'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring David Peckham (organist, U.S.A). August 5, (2007?) (A4 poster)[Includes photograph of David Peckham]

'Let's Go to the Movies!'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Ron Clark (organist). September 16, (2007?) (A4 poster)

'Pops On Pipes'. With Brett Valiant (USA), on the Wurlitzer Organ. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. September 13, 2009 (A4 poster)

'The Gift of Music'. With Ryan Heggie and Chris McPhee (Australia), on organ and piano. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. October 18, 2009 (A4 poster)

'Modern Times' starring Charlie Chaplin, accompanied by Ron Clark on The Wurlitzer Organ. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. November 22, 2009 (A4 poster)

'Blackpool comes to Hollywood'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Chris Powell (organist, U.K). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. March 21, (2010?) (A4 poster)[Includes photograph of Chris Powell]

'City Lights' starring Charlie Chaplin, accompanied by Ron Clark on The Wurlitzer Organ. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. May 2, 2010 (A4 poster)

'A Local Artist Variety Concert'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Ron Clark. Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. June 17, 2012 (A4 poster, tickets - 2 copies)[Includes photograph of Ron Clark]

'Is it true what they say about Dixie?'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring Scott Harrison (organist) and Lex Pistols (Dixieland Jazz Band). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. September 23, (2012?) (A4 poster)[Includes photographs of Scott Harrison, Lex Pistols]

'The Sights and Sounds of the Mighty Wurlitzer At The Movies'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring John Atwell (from Melbourne), Brett Lowe (singer). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. April 14, 2013 (A4 poster)

'Pops On Pipes!'. Presented by the Wurlitzer Organ Trust of Auckland. Featuring David Gray (on tour from Scotland). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St Georges Bay Rd, Avondale. September 8, 2013 (A4 poster)

'Two's Company' - An Afternoon of Music With Auckland's Historic Wurlitzer Organ. Including Chris McPhee and Rosanne Hosking (from Adelaide). Performed at the Hollywood Cinema, St George's Road, Avondale. June 21, 2015 (A4 poster)
